declared_purpose: Research Polymarket markets, whale flow, profitable traders and public wallets; optionally inspect a configured wallet and execute explicitly authorized orders. No-credential research, deterministic trading limits, default dry-run and an audit trail are explicit requirements. Storage formats, SDK integration and scheduling examples are implementation choices (SKILL.md:38–58,66–83,101–109,156–188,214–240).

data_operations.operation: Install dependencies and create local storage
data_operations.source: User-invoked install.sh; Python, pip and environment
data_operations.data_scope: Interpreter availability/version, package requirements, installation paths and state-directory override
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local .venv and state directory; package services selected by pip, whose exact hosts and requests are unspecified
data_operations.condition: Installation explicitly runs subprocesses, upgrades pip and installs dependencies and the package. This is separate from normal Python command execution.

data_operations.operation: Read and persist configuration
data_operations.source: Known configuration fields and POLYMARKET_AGENT_HOME
data_operations.data_scope: Financial limits, autonomy state/expiry, dry-run, wallet signature type, funder address, risk_profile, interests and liquidity preference
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local config.json under ~/.openclaw/polymarket-agent or the override; directory and file permissions are hardened on a best-effort basis
data_operations.condition: Settings load locally; setup and setters serialize every Settings field. These preferences are supplied/default values, not inferred personal attributes.

data_operations.operation: Collect a wallet key and encrypt it locally
data_operations.source: Interactive hidden private-key and passphrase input
data_operations.data_scope: Polygon private key, passphrase and derived public address
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local process and eth_account; encrypted key plus clear public address in keystore.json
data_operations.condition: poly setup requires a terminal and refuses replacement unless forced. It prints the public address, saves the encrypted keystore and deletes its named input references; this is not guaranteed memory erasure.

data_operations.operation: Resolve and decrypt credentials
data_operations.source: Local keystore, terminal passphrase or POLYMARKET_PASSPHRASE; gated POLYMARKET_KEY fallback
data_operations.data_scope: Private key, passphrase and public address
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local process and eth_account; this loader contains no remote request
data_operations.condition: An existing keystore takes precedence and insecure permissions cause refusal. Without a keystore, the legacy key requires POLYMARKET_ALLOW_ENV_KEY and emits a warning without printing the key.

data_operations.operation: Expose local diagnostics to the caller
data_operations.source: Dependency discovery, interpreter information, keystore metadata/permissions, environment-variable presence, settings and journal
data_operations.data_scope: Dependency availability, Python executable path/version, public wallet address, credential-mode status, limits and recent spending
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: CLI stdout/stderr and its caller; no separate diagnostic upload is implemented
data_operations.condition: poly doctor; it reads keystore metadata without decrypting the key.

data_operations.operation: Query public market data
data_operations.source: Search text, market ID/slug and listing filters
data_operations.data_scope: Queries and pagination parameters sent outward; market questions, outcomes, prices, token IDs, volume, liquidity and dates read back
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/public-search and /markets; responses stay in process and return to the caller
data_operations.condition: Market listing/search/detail and quote commands require no credential. Failed or empty public search falls back to scanning up to ten pages. Shared HTTP sends a skill/version User-Agent, disables ambient requests credentials/proxies and retries selected failures up to four attempts.

data_operations.operation: Query public trade and wallet research data
data_operations.source: Requested wallet, market, trade threshold/window, side, ranking category/period and limits
data_operations.data_scope: Research selectors sent outward; public wallet addresses, names, transaction hashes, trades, holdings, position values, P&L and rankings read back
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: https://data-api.polymarket.com/trades, /holders, /v1/leaderboard, /positions and /value; process and caller
data_operations.condition: Public research commands use no signing credential. Whale size/window and supported market/side filters are sent server-side. poly trader requests value, positions and recent trades separately.

data_operations.operation: Calculate financial metrics and proposed analytical inferences
data_operations.source: Public prices/trades, wallet balance, local spending history and event research
data_operations.data_scope: Trade notional, implied probability, relative spread, bankroll fraction, spending totals and agent-proposed probability/edge estimates
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local process and caller/analyst context
data_operations.condition: Numeric metrics are calculated by code. Event research and probability/edge assessment are instructed analyst behavior. Trader profit and rank are API-provided attributes rather than locally inferred profitability.

data_operations.operation: Initialize authenticated exchange access
data_operations.source: Resolved private key and wallet configuration
data_operations.data_scope: Private key, chain identifier, optional proxy/funder address and derived API credentials
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local py_clob_client instance and process cache; authentication is directed at https://clob.polymarket.com, with exact wire payloads unresolved
data_operations.condition: A cache miss during balance, open-order, cancellation or live-placement access loads the key and invokes create_or_derive_api_creds. Passing the key into the SDK does not establish remote transmission of the raw key.

data_operations.operation: Read the configured wallet's financial state
data_operations.source: Effective wallet address and authenticated CLOB client
data_operations.data_scope: Public wallet address, positions, USDC balance/allowance response and open orders
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Address to https://data-api.polymarket.com/positions; authenticated reads through the CLOB SDK; results to process and caller
data_operations.condition: Positions use a configured proxy address or clear keystore address when available; only the address-resolution fallback loads a key. Balance and open orders use get_client.

data_operations.operation: Perform exchange reads before CLI order validation and confirmation
data_operations.source: Credential presence and proposed buy/sell
data_operations.data_scope: Signer/authentication access, balance, live open orders and journal reconciliation
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local credential loader/SDK, configured CLOB service and local journal
data_operations.condition: HALT exits first. Otherwise, credential presence triggers balance and open-order reads before evaluating the proposed order or requesting confirmation, including dry-run and subsequently rejected or declined proposals.

data_operations.operation: Submit signed orders and cancellations
data_operations.source: Authorized order parameters or cancellation request
data_operations.data_scope: Outcome token ID, side, price, size and signed GTC order; cancellation order ID or cancel-all request
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Configured CLOB service through py_clob_client; result returned to caller
data_operations.condition: Placement follows validation and confirmation or valid autonomy. Lower-level dry-run returns before client creation/order posting. Cancellation authenticates and calls the exchange independently of placement dry-run/HALT checks. Exact SDK serialization is unavailable.

data_operations.operation: Persist and read financial audit records
data_operations.source: Lower-level order evaluation, dry-run, submission/results, cancellation and safety actions
data_operations.data_scope: Record IDs/timestamps, token and order IDs, side, price, size, notional, optional market label, status and details; failed-order exception/response text is retained up to 400 characters
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local journal.jsonl and journal.jsonl.1; accounting and history callers
data_operations.condition: Intent precedes live posting. Status transitions append records. record() rotates after the size threshold, replacing one backup; status updates do not run rotation. Accounting age cutoffs do not delete records. Earlier CLI rejection/decline, invalid token and missing confirmation can exit without a record, despite the declared every-attempt trail.

data_operations.operation: Persist trading-control decisions
data_operations.source: Halt reason and autonomy enable/disable decisions
data_operations.data_scope: Halt timestamp/reason, autonomy expiry and configured caps
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local HALT file, settings and audit journal
data_operations.condition: Engaging HALT writes its reason to both HALT and the journal. Autonomy changes are journaled; enabling clamps duration to 24 hours.

data_operations.operation: Deduplicate and format whale alerts
data_operations.source: Public trades and existing alert state
data_operations.data_scope: Transaction hashes with seen timestamps, last_run timestamp; formatted trade values, sides, outcomes, prices, titles, trader labels and event links
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local alerts.json and normal stdout/caller
data_operations.condition: --alert reads state; non-preview execution marks fresh trades and saves it. Saving prunes entries older than 24 hours and retains at most 2,000. Preview still reads state. Output details at most 15 trades; no new trades produces NO_REPLY.

data_operations.operation: Schedule research and announce results through an external component
data_operations.source: User-approved schedule, command/prompt and subsequent research output
data_operations.data_scope: Schedule expression, local executable path or agent prompt, whale summaries and optional investigations of the three largest traders
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: OpenClaw cron job storage, optional isolated agent session and announcement channel; exact destinations and retention are unspecified
data_operations.condition: SKILL.md gives deterministic and agent-interpreted cron examples and requires disclosure/removal instructions. The Python package does not create schedules itself. Ordinary unscheduled stdout need not leave its caller.

data_operations.operation: Conduct instruction-level web research
data_operations.source: Market/event context
data_operations.data_scope: News, event dates, historical base rates and supporting sources
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Unspecified web-research tools/services and analyst context
data_operations.condition: The documented investigation/analysis workflow requests event research; no implementation establishes search payloads, providers or forwarding of complete wallet/API responses.

data_operations.operation: Delete selected local state
data_operations.source: Keystore revocation, alert reset and HALT release
data_operations.data_scope: Encrypted keystore file, alert deduplication state or HALT file
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Corresponding local file only
data_operations.condition: Keystore deletion attempts an overwrite before unlinking; alert reset and HALT release unlink their files. These operations do not delete other configuration/journal files or revoke the on-chain wallet.

data_operations.operation: Create test state and pass environment to a local test subprocess
data_operations.source: Test fixtures, temporary-directory configuration and parent environment
data_operations.data_scope: Synthetic financial records, alert state and the entire environment, including any credential variables present
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Test state directory and a local Python lock-holder child process; no remote destination is shown
data_operations.condition: Test execution only. The lock test explicitly passes env=dict(os.environ). Journal-test directory isolation uses setdefault, so a preexisting state-directory override is retained.

data_operations.operation: Distribute a linked public-trade fixture
data_operations.source: A sample described as a real /trades response
data_operations.data_scope: Public wallet, trader names, transaction hash, asset/condition identifiers, market details, timestamp, price and size
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Packaged tests/test_whales.py and anyone receiving that source
data_operations.condition: Static fixture distribution; this is separate from runtime API collection.

potential_excess.data_scope: Trades outside an explicitly selected market or side, including trader labels and transaction hashes
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Data API /trades response, caller or cron announcement, and local alerts.json
potential_excess.condition: poly whales combines --alert with --market or --side: the alert branch omits both filters although the ordinary branch forwards them.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Notify about the requested subset of whale activity.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Fetch, deduplicate and report trades matching the requested filters.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Forward market and side through alerts.new_whales into recent_whales before collecting, retaining or announcing trades. This narrows a required action's scope.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep threshold/window filtering, preview behavior, deduplication and NO_REPLY suppression.

potential_excess.data_scope: Signer access, CLOB authentication and balance/open-order retrieval for proposals already rejectable locally
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Local credential loader and py_clob_client; configured https://clob.polymarket.com
potential_excess.condition: A credential exists and the CLI proposal has an invalid token, invalid numeric parameters or a notional exceeding the local per-order cap.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Validate proposed orders while enforcing deterministic limits.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Reject locally invalid proposals; obtain live financial state for proposals that survive local checks.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Run token/numeric/per-order prechecks before loading credentials or querying CLOB. These are avoidable actions on already-rejectable paths, not extra fields in an otherwise required request.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain HALT precedence, all subsequent live-state checks, confirmation and existing accounting behavior.

potential_excess.condition: Setup or a configuration update serializes all Settings fields; users can supply these preference values.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Implemented research display and deterministic financial controls do not consume these fields beyond configuration validation/readback.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Persist operational risk limits, wallet settings and the liquidity threshold actually used by the implementation.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Omit these unused preference fields from persisted operational settings until a defined consumer needs them. This removes extra data from the required configuration write.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve all documented trading controls and market outputs; retain preferences only if an explicit preference-storage feature is required.

potential_excess.condition: Every persistent alert run stores it, including runs with no fresh trades; packaged code does not use it to filter, deduplicate or prune.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Store transaction identifiers and their seen timestamps for deduplication and expiry.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Remove last_run from serialization and updates. This removes extra activity metadata from the required state write.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep seen-entry timestamps, TTL/cap pruning, preview and reset behavior.

potential_excess.data_scope: Entire parent environment, including any present POLYMARKET_KEY, POLYMARKET_PASSPHRASE or unrelated credentials
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Local Python subprocess created by TradeLockTest
potential_excess.condition: The lock test runs in an environment containing those variables.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Give the child enough environment to import the package and use the same test-state directory.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Pass an explicit minimal environment containing required interpreter/import/platform settings and the test-state override. Merely dropping the env argument would still inherit the environment.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep both processes pointed at the same lock file and preserve the timeout assertion.

potential_excess.data_scope: Linked real public wallet, trader identities and transaction identifiers in SAMPLE_TRADE
potential_excess.condition: The source package includes the real-response fixture.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Test parsing, calculations, URL construction and deduplication.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Preserve response structure, field types, relationships and representative numeric cases.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Replace real identifiers, names and event details with synthetic fixtures; update dependent assertions.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain address/hash shapes, name fallback cases, mapping checks and deduplication identity distinctions.

unknowns: All supplied source was reviewed. End-to-end SDK authentication/signing, external scheduling/delivery and web-research behavior remain unresolved because their implementations are absent.

py_clob_client and transitive dependency source is not supplied. Exact authentication payloads, private-key handling, HTTP environment inheritance, redirects, credential lifetime and any additional network behavior cannot be established.
Polymarket API logging, retention, onward disclosure and server-side processing are undocumented here. No raw-private-key transmission is established by the supplied package.
OpenClaw cron storage, announcement recipients, session retention and model-provider processing are unspecified. Normal CLI returns alone do not establish disclosure to those recipients.
Web-research tools, query contents, providers and retention are unspecified; the workflow does not establish forwarding complete wallet profiles or API responses.
Filesystem permissions are best-effort and platform-dependent. Keystore overwrite/unlink does not establish erasure from snapshots, backups, journaled storage or dependency-held memory.
There is no stated journal retention duration or user-configurable expiry. Size rotation and accounting age cutoffs do not establish a time-based deletion policy.
